errors.evidence: The description of Line 3's trend after 1995 is completely incorrect. The chart shows that Line 3 (triangles) rises steadily from about 11% in 2005 to about 20% in 2020. The description claims it falls to 10% by 2014, which is factually wrong.
Line 4 (squares) begins at approximately 25% in 1984, not 23%.
Line 5 (dotted green) begins at approximately 11.5% in 1984, not 9%.
The description for Line 6 is inaccurate. The line does not fall to 9% by 1990; it rises initially and then falls to its lowest point of around 9.5% around 1993.
